headline: Holmgren Bullies BrookynDynasty as Jokić Bricks
subhead: Gopher Gold took the night 10-1 behind Chet Holmgren's 17 rebounds and 4 blocks while Nikola Jokić shot 5 for 19.

zingers.line: Nikola Jokić went 5 for 19, Gopher Gold won the night 10-1, and BrookynDynasty now trails 7-4.
Jamal Murray shot 2 for 11 with 6 turnovers, the worst brick of the night, and White Mambas lead only 6-5.
theInfamous trails 10-1, and Peyton Watson answered with 8 points, 2 for 7 shooting and 5 turnovers.
Donovan Mitchell dropped 32 and 10, DeMar DeRozan added 5 turnovers, and Zero Fox Given still trails Acinonyx 10-1.
James Harden led the league in turnovers with 6, and Acinonyx slid three spots in the power rankings.
Thug Life did not start a single player last night and still lost the night 4-1 to LeParth James.
Suggs to be you sent out Cason Wallace alone, and MONSTARS ☄️ took the night 6-2 anyway.

night: Chet Holmgren posted 12 points, 17 rebounds and 4 blocks on 5 for 9 shooting for Gopher Gold, the best line of the night.
Jamal Murray went 2 for 11 with 6 turnovers for White Mambas, the worst brick of the night, and White Mambas lost the night 4-3.
Nikola Jokić shot 5 for 19 for BrookynDynasty, which got flattened 10-1 on the night by Gopher Gold.
James Harden coughed up a league-worst 6 turnovers for Acinonyx.
Thug Life did not start a single player and lost the night 4-1 to LeParth James.
